name: Shiv Kumar
tagline: Hello everyone! I study Computer Science specialized in Cloud Computing at Techno India University. I work on Java projects, software development, and build software for data and systems.
aboutBio: Computer Science, cloud infrastructure, and machine learning. I'm interested in what happens when ideas meet real-world constraints — when systems have to scale, algorithms have to prove themselves, and software has to work beyond the demo. Most of what I build is an attempt to explore those boundaries in public.

aboutFragments.label: RESEARCH
aboutFragments.body: Cloud computing systems, distributed infrastructure, and machine-learning evaluation pipelines. Exploring container orchestration, performance benchmarking, and cloud-native backend architectures.

aboutFragments.label: BUILDING
aboutFragments.body: Software projects across Java enterprise frameworks, cloud computing microservices, and web platforms. Focused on high-availability systems, clean code, and practical tooling.

aboutFragments.label: SYSTEMS
aboutFragments.body: Cloud architectures, virtualized computing environments, database optimization, and scalable backend pipelines designed for predictable throughput and operational reliability.
